podcasts.title: The AI Agent Race: Perplexity Teammates, Meta Muse & GPT-6 Cyber
podcasts.description: AI is moving beyond answers and into getting things done. Jaeden Schafer breaks down the latest wave of AI agents, including Perplexity Teammates, Meta Muse’s voice and avatar features, and Airbnb’s plans for an AI travel assistant. This AI Chat news roundup also covers OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber, Thinking Machines’ Inkling model, Google’s video-generation updates, Anthropic’s work on protein research, and the debate over AI regulation and data-center costs. What makes an agent genuinely useful—and which tools are worth paying for? Jaeden shares his perspective on computer control, automation, and the practical value behind the announcements. podcasts.title: AI:AM: Is THIS the AI We Want? Alarming Acceleration, AI Election Bets, GPU Trading & AI-Native VC
podcasts.description: Nathan Labenz and Prakash Narayanan examine mounting evidence of rapid AI acceleration alongside guests Brian Zhou of Thoughtful, Mike San Miguel of Luxor Technology, and Bryan Bischof of Theory Ventures. The discussions unpack how frontier agents fared when trading real money on midterm election forecasts, the intense physical constraints and compliance rules shaping secondary GPU transactions, and how venture firms use thousands of agent runs to identify alpha. Anchored by METR's assessment and Anthropic's amended regulatory filings, the hosts explore whether frontier labs are on the brink of dramatic, AI-driven progress that could outpace human oversight. Together, they confront the stakes of an imminent takeoff into an agentic economy and debate how rapidly advancing autonomous systems must be governed.
